critical_path.diagnosis: Critical path is dominated by clock-network skew (4.254 ns, source clock leg) + the 2.0 ns output_delay budget asked by the task spec. Internal logic only 0.642 ns total (2 LUTs). This is NOT the u_sched/u_vision_fifo BRAM access that the A2 task spec hypothesized as bottleneck — the critical path moved post phys_opt.

A1b_io_budget_1.5_0.2_in_flight.rationale: Spec's 2.0/0.3 I/O budget puts 4.667 ns of internal budget at 6.667 ns target; v5 OOC convention used 1.5/0.2 which yields 5.167 ns and was the budget v5/v6 demonstrated. Re-running with this looser budget to test whether the design itself can close at 150 MHz under a more typical I/O margin.
A1b_io_budget_1.5_0.2_in_flight.preroute_phys_opt_status: POSITIVE (post place + phys_opt only, prior to route_design)
A1b_io_budget_1.5_0.2_in_flight.postroute_diagnosis: route_design re-introduced large negative slack (-2.85 ns delta from preroute estimate). Routing congestion under the 1.5 ns I/O budget is worse than under the 2.0 ns budget, even though logic budget is looser — the placer chose a more aggressive placement that route cannot achieve.
A1b_io_budget_1.5_0.2_in_flight.phase_13_postroute_physopt: in progress; expected to land between -1.5 and -2.0 ns based on warning 'Post-Route Physical Optimization is most effective when WNS is above -0.5ns'

acceptance_criteria_check.status_DONE: PARTIAL — A1 produced impl_ok=true with WNS=-0.293 ns (0.293 ns short of >= 0 target). A2 (FIFO pipelining) does NOT match the actual critical path which is the I/O output_delay path, so A2 cannot fix this. The deliverable is Fmax=143.7 MHz, not 150 MHz.

human_ack_reasons: WNS @ 150 MHz target = -0.293 ns; achievable Fmax under spec I/O budget = 143.7 MHz. Paper claim should be '143.7 MHz post-route [HW-IMPL]' OR adjust I/O budget assumption (1.5/0.3 hybrid) and re-run.

A2 spec assumption WRONG: the critical path is NOT u_sched/u_vision_fifo (FIFO pipelining would not help). The path is u_vit/wreq_throttle internal counter -> ddrOUT output port, with 4.254 ns clock skew + 2.0 ns output_delay dominating.

Two remediation options: (i) accept 143.7 MHz with current 2.0/0.3 I/O budget as honest closure, or (ii) re-run with 1.5/0.3 hybrid budget (loose output_delay, keep input). Option (ii) requires another ~45-60 min vivado run.
next_action_for_orch: Decide between (A) publishing 143.7 MHz post-route as the [HW-IMPL] number — close enough to 150 MHz to honor the H1 reframing intent, or (B) approving a fresh hybrid-I/O re-run targeting WNS >= 0 at the cost of additional implementation time and possible router congestion regression. A1b (1.5/0.2 hybrid) currently shows worse routing congestion than A1; (B) would use 1.5 output_delay / 0.3 input.
